EncryptionUtils.caesar_cipher:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Implements a case-preserving Caesar cipher by shifting each alphabetic character by the given shift modulo 26 and leaving all non-alphabetic characters unchanged." caesar_cipher]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> plaintext </REF>: string "The input string to be encrypted."
        <REF> shift </REF>: integer "The number of positions by which alphabetic characters are shifted."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> ciphertext </REF>: string "The resulting string after applying the Caesar cipher shift to each alphabetic character."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize ciphertext to an empty string. RESULT ciphertext]
            [COMMAND For each character char in plaintext, execute the matching alternative flow to update ciphertext based on whether char is alphabetic and uppercase or lowercase. RESULT ciphertext]
            [COMMAND Return the final ciphertext string. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Within the for loop over plaintext, char.isalpha() is true and char.isupper() is true.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Set ascii_offset to 65. RESULT ascii_offset]
            [COMMAND Compute shifted_char as chr((ord(char) - ascii_offset + shift) % 26 + ascii_offset). RESULT shifted_char]
            [COMMAND Append shifted_char to ciphertext. RESULT ciphertext]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Within the for loop over plaintext, char.isalpha() is true and char.isupper() is false.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Set ascii_offset to 97. RESULT ascii_offset]
            [COMMAND Compute shifted_char as chr((ord(char) - ascii_offset + shift) % 26 + ascii_offset). RESULT shifted_char]
            [COMMAND Append shifted_char to ciphertext. RESULT ciphertext]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Within the for loop over plaintext, char.isalpha() is false.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Append char to ciphertext unchanged. RESULT ciphertext]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
EncryptionUtils.vigenere_cipher:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Encrypts plain_text using the Vigenère cipher by shifting alphabetic characters based on the current key letter, preserving case and non-alphabetic characters, and advancing the key only for alphabetic characters." vigenere_cipher]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> plain_text </REF>: string "The text to be encrypted."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> encrypted_text </REF>: string "The encrypted string after applying the Vigenère cipher to plain_text."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize encrypted_text to an empty string. RESULT encrypted_text]
            [COMMAND Initialize key_index to 0. RESULT key_index]
            [COMMAND For each char in plain_text in order from first to last, execute the following logic within the loop. RESULT char]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over plain_text, if char.isalpha() is true, compute shift as ord(self.key[key_index % len(self.key)].lower()) - ord('a'), producing an integer from 0 to 25. RESULT shift]
            [COMMAND Within the char.isalpha() true branch, compute encrypted_char as chr((ord(char.lower()) - ord('a') + shift) % 26 + ord('a')). RESULT encrypted_char]
            [COMMAND Within the char.isalpha() true branch, if char.isupper() is true, append encrypted_char.upper() to encrypted_text; otherwise append encrypted_char. RESULT encrypted_text]
            [COMMAND Within the char.isalpha() true branch, increment key_index by 1. RESULT key_index]
            [COMMAND After the loop over plain_text completes, return encrypted_text. RESULT encrypted_text]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Within the loop over plain_text, the current char is not alphabetic, so char.isalpha() is false.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Append char unchanged to encrypted_text and leave key_index unchanged. RESULT encrypted_text]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
EncryptionUtils.rail_fence_cipher:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Encrypts plain_text by arranging its characters in a zigzag rail-fence pattern of the given rail count and then reading the rows in order while skipping newline placeholders." rail_fence_cipher]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> plain_text </REF>: str "The plaintext string to be encrypted."
        <REF> rails </REF>: int "The number of rails used in the rail fence cipher."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> encrypted_text </REF>: str "The encrypted string produced by reading the fence matrix row by row and skipping newline placeholders."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize fence as a 2D list with rails rows and len(plain_text) columns, where every cell is set to the newline character '\n'. RESULT fence]
            [COMMAND Initialize direction to -1, row to 0, and col to 0. RESULT traversal_state]
            [COMMAND For each character char in plain_text, if row equals 0 or row equals rails - 1 with short-circuit evaluation, set direction = -direction. RESULT direction]
            [COMMAND Within the same loop over plain_text, after the boundary direction update, assign fence[row][col] = char. RESULT fence_after_write]
            [COMMAND Within the same loop over plain_text, increment col by 1 and then update row = row + direction. RESULT traversal_state_after_advance]
            [COMMAND Initialize encrypted_text to the empty string ''. RESULT encrypted_text]
            [COMMAND For each i from 0 to rails - 1 inclusive, for each j from 0 to len(plain_text) - 1 inclusive, if fence[i][j] is not equal to the newline character '\n', append fence[i][j] to encrypted_text. RESULT encrypted_text_after_collection]
            [COMMAND Return encrypted_text. RESULT encrypted_text]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
